testsuite.name: io.libp2p.mux.mplex.MplexHandlerTest

testcase.name: test writing to remotely open stream upon activation()
write with localDisconnected should fail promise without throwing from doWrite()
test large message is split onto slices()
local create and after remote disconnect should still write()
test remote and local disconnect closes stream()
test that readComplete event is fired to child channel()
should throw when writing to closed connection()
local create and after local disconnect should still read()
should throw when writing to locally closed stream()
should throw when writing to reset stream()
resetting non existing stream doesnt close connection()
opening a stream with existing id causes connection close()
test that readComplete event is fired to reading channels only()
